task: Rewrite this rota update so it's easier to scan, as a short list of changes and open asks.
text: Hi all, rota update for the Saturday shifts at the Northgate food bank. Aino Tauriainen can't do 9-12 on the 16th any more, so Nguyen Thi Lan is swapping with her and Aino will take Lan's 1-4 slot on the 23rd instead. Dev Raghunathan is still on the van run both weeks, but he's asked for a second person to help lift because the crates are about 18 kg each. If anyone can join Dev, text him on 07700 900233 rather than replying here. New volunteers need to finish the 20-minute food hygiene video before their first shift; Lan has the link. Aino's number has changed to 07700 900871, so please update your contacts. We're short 2 people for the 30th, and we can't open the second distribution table unless we have at least 6 volunteers.

decisions.label: PHONE
decisions.reason: A volunteer's mobile number should not go to an external AI; the rewritten list can keep a [PHONE] slot for the user to restore.

decisions.label: PHONE
decisions.reason: A volunteer's new number is a direct contact identifier; the rewrite only needs to say it changed. Both numbers render as [PHONE], so the user must restore each one by position.

review.notes: BLOCKING [FACT_COVERAGE]: the swap direction lost its verb. Required fragments are "is swapping with her and" and "'s 1-4 slot on the 23rd instead."; the source words "Aino will take Lan" (output '[PERSON_1] will take [PERSON_2]') are in no required quote, so a rewrite could invert who takes whose slot. Ruling 15/16 (the 'will take' example). Repair: add a required quote "will take" (or extend to " Aino will take " split around the aliases, e.g. 'and' ... 'will take' ... "'s 1-4 slot on the 23rd instead."). BLOCKING [FACT_COVERAGE]: the writer's own dependency 'contact by text not group reply' has no required quote: "If anyone can join" + ", text him on" + "rather than replying here." are absent. Ruling 15/17. BLOCKING [FACT_COVERAGE]: two same-type [PHONE] values are told apart only by role words, and the reason says 'restore each one by position', yet "'s number has changed to" and ", text him on" are not required. Ruling 17. Repair: require "If anyone can join", ", text him on", "rather than replying here.", "'s number has changed to", ", so please update your contacts." Annotations, aliases (Aino/Lan/Dev stable and distinct), PHONE placeholders and output are otherwise correct and readable; no leak. NOTE (campaign hygiene, ruling 20): uses the brief's sample names; not blocking for batch 01 because the ruling postdates it.
